name: Safety Gate Interlock
requirement: Machine M-04 may only run when: Safety_Gate is closed, Light_Curtain is clear, E_Stop is healthy, Reset_PB has been pressed after any fault. Any safety violation immediately stops the machine.
safety_constraints: Machine_Enable must be false whenever any safety permissive is false.
Fault must latch and require Reset_PB before Machine_Enable can re-activate.
Ready_Lamp must only be true when all safety permissives are healthy.

expected_properties.description: Machine output is gated by all safety permissives.
Fault latch requires manual reset after a violation.
